items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Jack Washington, Carl Smith and Joe Jones

ctx.x: "You always miss the boat." But I was happy out there with Nat Toles and they used to come back out there and Andy knew what kind of band we had with Nat Toles' band. So they came back that summer to play Kansas City and we were playing near Kansas City, about 90 miles at a town, Trenton, New Jersey, with the band. So Andy called me down in Trenton, he says, "Look, there's a fella coming down and this cat's got a lot of money and he's got a lot of power and actually, he's looking for a good band." He says, "I…
But John Hammond and Bennie liked what they heard, you know? They had heard it from the Congress Hotel, Bennie was in the Congress and they liked what they heard. So --
